beats.onScreen: End card: Centred: VESPER / DRIFT wordmark (typeset), then the gold R7 Orbit mark and the made-by reveal. No end-screen placeholders. Audio: black-hole ambience bed (see Audio plan).
beats.lineRaw: (none)
beats.overlayRaw: The reveal (only here, for the wow factor): `THIS VIDEO WAS MADE ENTIRELY BY R7 ORBIT` / `EDITED, SCRIPTED AND BUILT BY A TEAM OF AI AGENTS IN R7 ORBIT` / `DIRECTED BY HUNTER`

lines: THIS VIDEO WAS MADE ENTIRELY BY R7 ORBIT
EDITED, SCRIPTED AND BUILT BY A TEAM OF AI AGENTS IN R7 ORBIT

cues.text: I didn't want one AI to build my game. I wanted a team.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Welcome to R7 Orbit.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Basically, vibe coding on steroids.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: What ideas do I have? I literally have no ideas.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: So I opened R7 Orbit, and I started like any studio would: with research.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Gravity wells to hit targets using as little fuel as possible.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: That sounds boring.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Actually, I have an idea.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: There's this one game that I like on Steam...
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: There it is, Drifter Star.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: I want to build my own clone version of this,
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: because I'm really creative and have so many ideas.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Let's just use Orbit to orchestrate it all.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Come up with a plan to create a clone of it...
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: then we'll go from there
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: with a creative director agent to figure out the look and feel.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: One agent studied what makes a space game fun.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Another dug into how space actually works, so the game would feel real.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: I'm sure what we're going to get is going to be very decent at best.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Maybe. But Opus crushes it.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: I want to let you loose, and I want you to just control everything from here on out.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: I want you to be the orchestrator...
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: and I want you to run the show.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Which is: 2D top-down, or 3D like the original?
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: 3D like the original.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Then I hired the specialists.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: A creative director to set the look and feel.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: I have a new creative director agent
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: that is going to be referencing the images that I gave it...
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: literally just grab these from Steam.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: A UI designer for the screens.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: A sound designer for the audio.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: An engine agent built the core, and a renderer agent took it into 3D,
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: while a simulation agent worked on a universe that never ends.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Yeah, an infinite universe.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: It's literally right there in front of my face.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: So everything will be procedurally generated.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: So you have Voyager, Quasar, Polaris, Laika.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: They all worked at the same time, on one canvas.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: They're probably all doing the same thing. They are.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Each had its own private copy of the project,
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: so no one could break anyone else's work.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Next, you need to merge all four branches into main.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Each task worktree is separate.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: When an agent needed permission, the card told me.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: We're going to allow, allow, allow, allow.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: I really wish it would stop asking me for permission to do things.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Go ahead and allow all of these to run free, and we're gonna see what happens.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: I could answer, or watch it work, or talk to it.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Shut up, R7, you didn't let me talk long enough.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: I'm upset with you.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: So if an agent is waiting on me, I will hear this ding here, that bell.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Atlas needs you.
cues.speaker: orbit

cues.text: This is how I will read answers to you.
cues.speaker: orbit

cues.text: I hate that voice.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Then came the hard part: pulling it all together.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Go ahead and merge this to main. To main, not me.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Merge it. Regular merge... Merge it.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: It's a new day. There were some merge conflicts.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Between Lark and Juno here: the engine and 3D renderer, and the UI designer.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: When two agents changed the same lines,
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Orbit sent the problem back to them to sort out.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: So I let Orbit know,
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: and then it went ahead and just sent follow-ups to each of them, on its own.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: So Lark is merged, no conflicts.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Now we're just waiting on Juno.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Their work flowed into the game on its own, and I decided what went on to GitHub.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Everything here is done. Go ahead, push this to GitHub...
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: All right, so then it's done.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: I'm going to sit the passenger seat for this one,
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: provide a little direction here and there, a little bit of help.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: If robots ever become real workers,
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: it's going to be so easy to manage them until they get upset.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: You fire one of their friends and then they try to kill you.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Then I handed one agent the job of playing the game
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: and checking that everything worked together.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: It was integrating.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: I stopped it because I wanted to use Opus 5.5 instead.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: From there it worked on its own.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: It pulled everyone's work together and played the game by itself, off camera.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: The integrate and playtest agent finished.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: It had issues actually merging though, so I had to get those fixed.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Is the game ready to be played?
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: And if so, can you open it in the browser?
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: All right, so this is Vesper Drift.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: I was hoping for better.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: I'm also not hearing any sound effects.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: I've evolved into an asteroid. Nice.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: It's not bad. I can work with it.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: This is the game now.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Graphics-wise, I like the 3D meteors.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: This is not really playable.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Opus did not cook with this, not gonna lie.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Oh well. The first version was better.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: $446... just on this game, which is not playable.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Granted, this is not money I'm actually spending...
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: I'm on the Max plan, and I've only used 17% for the week.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: I just played through it. It took 12 minutes.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: I died to a black hole.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: I just gave it a new prompt.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: As I was playing, I was just telling it things to fix.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: We need some stars in the background still.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: It sort of just feels like we're in a void, or underwater.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Can we add a menu, like a developer menu,
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: where I can choose what planet or evolution stage to start as, so I can test them?
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Polaris is done.
cues.speaker: orbit

cues.text: This looks a lot better. I like this a lot, actually.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: The developer start menu is done. Here's the dev start menu.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: By the end, I had been less of a coder and more of a director.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: This is the game.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: I will say, this feels very, very, very much like Drifter Star.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: I might leave that out, so it's not copying every single thing from Drifter Star...
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: even though it's copied everything else.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: It looks so good. This is all in the browser.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Very impressed.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: This just shows you how big things are.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: This is what happens when you get to the black hole stage.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: It gets kind of crazy.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Oh, beat it.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: So far I'd say the clone is a big success.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: This is definitely a game I could see myself just playing when I'm bored.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: I might start another project and have Orbit actually just edit this video for me,
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: and choose all the highlights, and just make it for me.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Okay, goodbye.
cues.speaker: creator

cues.text: Rigel is done.
cues.speaker: orbit
